knowledge.purpose: Renders a recursive, expand/collapsible tree of nodes (label, optional icon, optional link, children) for hierarchical navigation or structure display.
useCases: Site navigation menu with nested sections (Navigation)
antiPatterns: Do not use for a flat list — use data.list instead
Not meant for very deep (10+ level) trees without external virtualization

jsonSchema.description: The heading level the title is drawn at, so the tree takes its place in the page outline (h2 for a page-level section, h3 under one).
The tree is a navigation landmark (<nav>): named by its title, or by navLabel when given. Set it when the tree is the page or section navigation (a docs sidebar).
The accessible name of the nav landmark when the tree has no visible title (or a different name is wanted), e.g. Documentation.

props.name: nodes
props.type: { id: string; label: string; icon?: string; href?: string; children?: TreeNode[] }[]

children.description: Child nodes, the same shape at every depth (checked one level deep).

jsonSchema.description: Tree nodes: [{id, label, href?, children?[]}] — recursive expand/collapse.
Node ids expanded on first render.
href of the page in view: its node is marked as the current page (aria-current="page") and the branch holding it opens. Set it whenever the tree is the page's navigation.
